sources.title: SNEDAI current online pre-enrolment and authority-approval procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, State-recognised Côte d’Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live service says SNEDAI is the only visa-request site recognised and approved by the State of Côte d’Ivoire; it confines online requests to ordinary passports and states authority approval remains discretionary.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le simple fait de formuler une demande du E-visa ne donne pas droit à l’obtention du visa d’entrée.

sources.title: SNEDAI current Abidjan airport biometric-visa issuance stage
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, State-recognised Côte d’Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The same current State-recognised procedure requires a favourable pre-enrolment document before boarding and describes the biometric airport stage where the visa is physically issued.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Il y effectue son enrôlement biométrique et le visa est imprimé et délivré immédiatement.

sources.title: SNEDAI live list of countries exempt from Côte d’Ivoire entry visas
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, State-recognised Côte d’Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live SNEDAI visa page embeds this image in its entry-visa-exemption popup. The image expressly covers ordinary and official passports, but the surrounding page does not state it closes airport-route eligibility.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les nationaux des pays ci-dessus, détenteurs de passeport ordinaire ou officiel ne sont pas soumis à l’obligation de visa.

sources.title: Côte d’Ivoire Embassy in Italy reference to the four-group visa framework
sources.publisher: Embassy of Côte d’Ivoire in Italy, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official mission page identifies the 1993 order and circulars as the nationality-group framework, but its referenced annex is not supplied on the page.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les textes classifient les pays en quatre groupes A, B, C et D.

sources.title: Djibouti eVisa applicant service
sources.officialityEvidence: Current HTTP 200 HTTPS replay returns the public applicant frontend (Last-Modified 15 December 2025). Its delivered assets did not disclose a stable unauthenticated nationality eligibility endpoint or terminal ordinary-passport result.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: Live verified-TLS Liberia Immigration Service application portal expressly makes use of VOA depend on the existence of a Liberian embassy in the applicant's country.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The same current LIS portal distinguishes a PDF confirmation from final physical visa issuance after arrival, biometric collection and officer processing at Roberts International Airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once completed, you will receive a visa sticker in your passport.

sources.title: Service Delivery Charter
sources.officialityEvidence: Live LIS January 2025 Service Delivery Charter states its 2024–2029 operating period. Its VOA service covers named broad groups but preserves a separate, unpublished eligibility test, host letter and seven-working-day processing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens from Countries who meet the eligibility criteria to enter Liberia.

sources.title: Discover Liberia: Entry & visas
sources.officialityEvidence: Live official tourism guidance uses generic eVisa language but says only 'most visitors' and directs confirmation. It is neither a nationality schedule nor evidence of electronic final visa issuance against LIS's current airport-sticker workflow.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Most visitors — including US, UK, EU, Canadian and Australian passport holders — need a visa before boarding.
